:::{#exr-rank-product-full-rank-practice}
#### Finding the rank of a product with a full-column-rank factor

@cor-rank-product-full-rank says that a left factor with [full column rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-full-column-rank)
keeps the [rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-rank) of the right factor.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1},
\qquad
\matr{B} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4}.
$$

Find $\rankf{\matr{A}\matr{B}}$ without multiplying.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Check that $\matr{A}$ has [full column rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-full-column-rank), and find $\rankf{\matr{B}}$.

:::

:::
